## Location & Surrounding Landmarks

Arya Plaza is strategically located at J.P. Chowk on Purabsarai Road, one of Munger's busiest and highest-footfall commercial thoroughfares. It features a unique dual-road through-access connecting the front main market road (J.P. Chowk / Purabsarai) directly to the rear municipal road (Bekapur).

Key nearby localities within 1–2 km:
- **J.P. Chowk** (0 meters — Front Entrance)
- **Purabsarai Commercial Market** (Directly on road)
- **Bekapur Market** (Directly connected via back entrance)
- **Belan Bazar** (~600 meters)
- **Lallu Pokhar** (~800 meters)
- **Bari Bazar Munger** (~1.2 km)
- **Jamalpur Junction** (~7 km)

## Commercial Unit Types & Specifications

1. **Ground Floor Commercial Retail Shops:**
   - Frontage: ~7–8 feet wide front shutter
   - Depth: ~25 feet deep
   - Ideal for: Retail stores, pharmacies, electronics, jewelry, clothing boutiques, customer service outlets.
   - Highlights: Heavy daily pedestrian and vehicular footfall, high visibility shutter frontage, attached overhead storage.

2. **Dual-Access Showrooms & Commercial Office Spaces:**
   - Features: Accessible from both J.P. Chowk main road and Bekapur back road.
   - Ideal for: Brand showrooms, diagnostics centers, bank branch / micro-finance offices, coaching centers, corporate offices.
   - Highlights: Dual customer flow, cross ventilation, front 10x10 ft open display / parking space.

3. **Overhead Storage & Godown Units:**
   - Dedicated upper-deck storage built above the retail floor for inventory-heavy wholesale and retail operations.

4. **Upcoming 1st Floor 2BHK Residential Unit:**
   - Modern 2-bedroom residential apartment currently under development.

## The Arya Spaces Digital Rent System

Every tenancy at Arya Plaza is digitally powered by the **Arya Spaces** property management platform:
- **Owner Console:** Real-time occupancy tracking, digital rent ledger, instant receipt generation, maintenance ticketing, and financial reporting.
- **Tenant Mobile App:** Secure PIN login, live rent due countdown, instant online/cash payment recording, digital agreement viewing, and maintenance request logging.
- **Tenant Android APK Download:** Available directly from https://github.com/aryanony/arya-spaces-releases/releases/download/renter-v1.0.0/app-release.apk

- **Q: Is any brokerage charged at Arya Plaza?**
  **A:** No. Every shop and office at Arya Plaza is leased directly by the property owner (Aaryan Gupta) with 0% brokerage.

  **A:** Commercial shop rent ranges from approximately ₹12,500/month for standard ground floor retail units up to ₹22,500/month for larger showroom/office spaces depending on size, position, and lease tenure. Contact +91 62056 50368 for exact up-to-date pricing.
- **Q: Is parking or display space available?**
